text: A service listens on 127.0.0.1:5432 rather than 0.0.0.0:5432. What is the difference?
choices: Loopback-only means it is unreachable from the network entirely; 0.0.0.0 means reachable from any interface
explanation: That single line of `ss` output is the difference between an exposed database and a safe one, and it is visible nowhere else. Reading listening sockets is a troubleshooting skill and a security review skill simultaneously.
